_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); revenue, margin, expense and receivables signals with Google's rule-T thresholds

pit_profile.why: 'We generate revenues primarily by delivering online advertising that consumers find relevant and that advertisers find cost-effective.' 'We generate a significant portion of our revenues from advertising, and a reduction in spending by or loss of advertisers could seriously harm our business.' 'We face intense competition.' 'As our growth rate has slowed, the cyclicality and seasonality in our business has become more pronounced and caused our operating results to fluctuate.' 'In addition, expenditures by advertisers tend to be cyclical, reflecting overall economic conditions and budgeting and buying patterns.' (FY2014 10-K); CYCLICAL: the 10-K says so of its own business ('the cyclicality and seasonality in our business'), the BKR, CAT and NVDA reading, not an industry's words; no theme in taxonomy_eras.json is live for a search and advertising company on these dates (OFFSHORE is scoped to IT services; CLOUD, live from 2012-10-30, is scoped to public cloud displacing on-premise IT, and this 10-K names the cloud only for Google's own services, so it is out of scope (the AVGO FY2012 and NVDA reading); ECOMMERCE, live from 2015-01-01, is scoped to physical retail), so the watch list is empty; the competition named is a competitive field, not a theme, and stays here (the PEP obesity rule)

BEAR.desc: EPS +0.0%/yr (worst year FY05-FY14, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +13.5%/yr (Q4 revenue YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +26.1%/yr (FY05-FY14 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +62.7%/yr (best 2-yr run FY05-FY14, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: GOOG (retrospective, 2015-04-02) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.26x (32.6% downside to Bear $360.81 / +127.0% upside to Bull $1215.45) | Adj composite 1.97 vs market 1.77: gap +0.20 [FAIRLY VALUED] | +39% above the EPP floor $385.13 (19x FY15E $20.27) | Conservative 2-yr case: +22.4% total (+11.2%/yr) | At 26.4x FY15E the 15% hurdle price $708.24 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; revenue +15.3% YoY in Q4 2014, forward revenues +15.3% (Q4 2014 revenue growth (no Q1 2015 guide)); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
